title: juncus alpinus subsp. requienii
intro: Juncus alpinus subsp. requienii, commonly known as the Adam's Needle or Requien's Rush, is a type of flowering plant in the sedge family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and promoting wound healing due to its antimicrobial and antiseptic properties. The therapeutic actions of Juncus alpinus subsp. requienii include stimulating the immune system and acting as an anti-inflammatory agent. The bioactive constituents of this plant include terpenoids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
